_comment: Fill in the two hostnames before the first multi-host run; the addresses match the 10.42.0.0/24 subnet that tools/lan-up.sh and tools/pool-install.sh both assume, with the harness on .1 as the hotspot gateway. client_endpoint is the port the replay client binds for F-11 deliveries; it must be reachable INBOUND from every worker host, which is the check nothing else performs. The pool is the 1B model on both nodes because F-9 holds engine, model and quant constant across pool members, and pool-install.sh only fetches the 1B weights. Heterogeneity comes from ngl, which is F-9a.
